column1: # The ledger of what the plain reactions and the reshaped trees wait for (IMPLEMENTATION.md 8.3; Phase 3 tasks 3.2 to 3.4, Phase 4 tasks 4.2 and 4.3). One line for each engine piece a "// NEEDS" in Runtime/Player/Trees/ names, with the reactions and marks it would finish; each already does the rest at its simplest faithful version. Delete a line when its piece is built and what it names is finished. Ordered by how many reactions a piece would finish, then the trees' pieces by how many marks.

column2: what is missing

Ground that keeps acting on whatever stands in it, by condition or test: a pool or net that slows whoever wades in later, a slick that floats whoever comes to four doses in it, pools of damp left where they settle (now the condition goes with the enemies it reached, or only the reacting enemy is tested)
column3: The Ground Gives, Caught Light, Chokedamp, Fish Poison

column2: The reaction's own look beyond the placeholder puff (task 3.5 and the approved effects): the hidden flame, the roots on the floor, the jar's black ring, the scorched fern, the mock suns turning with the enemy
column3: Smoulder, Rot Roots, Shut in the Dark, Earthed, Mock Suns

column2: A cooldown kept per enemy rather than one clock per effect for all enemies (an elite's flinch once every 4 s, a bite once every half second, a heal of 8 a second)

Standing things that block movement and shots and can be struck: the iron-faced anvil stone (also "stone at its back" for Hammer and Anvil), the rimed mound of 1.5 m, the hollow trunk left where a girdled enemy dies
The side of the enemy a blow comes from (the face it showed the player, or its flanks)
An enemy freezing as a moment the reactions can answer ("at once if it freezes", "when it freezes")
Pickups: things on the floor the player picks up by walking over them (heal, a critical next blow, a charged blow); then they do not flower
A shove or throw of one enemy as a moment (a Gust, a ram, Riptide, a lift); a heavy blow stands in
A count set from an affliction's depth: thorns, one for each notch carried; a whirl's stagger scaled by its shards
A burst or ground that spares the enemy it starts from (the grounded enemy is struck by its own fern; the seized one is charged by its own film)
An enemy state that forbids dodging, leaping and stepping back, and draws the body lower when sunk
Discharges and arcs within 6 m that bend toward one enemy (the live flame) and burst again there, once every 0.8 s
A thrown body that meets something on the way: what it hits takes the discharge first
Deaths inside a ring as a moment: poisoned enemies dying inside give the jar every dose (to twelve, past the usual eight) and each kill inside feeds the player 4
Links that pass a share of weapon damage both ways, and a leash that keeps two enemies within 4 m (or one within 2 m of a spot); gods are never leashed
Poison held back on one enemy: it stops biting for a time, then every bite held back lands at once, doubled
A burst shaped as a star of cracks: only enemies standing on the seams are struck, not a disc
A hold that reaches gods at 0.4 of its time (now what cannot be frozen is not held)
Sundered past its usual three, up to five, so the plate falls at five
An affliction that stays for the rest of the fight (two minutes of keeping stand in)
The enemy's own blow landing on the player or the guard as a moment; and a condition that drifts to the nearest enemy within 6 m when its carrier dies
column3: The Grudge; the shared movement rule (a movement spell started as a blow would land counts as a perfect dodge): Wildfire Rush's and Lightning Rod's Masters

column2: Burns that bite harder on one enemy (twice as hard while it glows)
A finisher as the blow a condition answers, apart from any heavy blow
Things thrown from an enemy in a fan, each stopping at the first it touches, riding the way the enemy was last shoved
The player's grown things as sources: each grown thing within 8 m throws a bolt into the enemy (four at most)
Ground laid along the path a thrown enemy travels, with the doses shed shared among the enemies it settles on

Forms the branches' shapes ask for and the built forms only approach: a cobra of flame that spits, a stone falling with its shadow growing, a wall of flame that carries a crowd, a drive back out in smoke, a cloud that drops bolts as you strike, a bolt path drawn with the stick, cuts on one line, an end behind the last enemy with a shape of light left to be struck, a rod that pulls to itself, drums of cloud
column3: Uraeus, Meteor Leap's Falling Star, Wildfire Rush's Fire Front and Smoke Road, Chain Lance's Stepped Leader, Waiting Thunder's Hanging Cloud and Hammer Fall, Seven Flashes' One Flash and Left Behind, Lightning Rod's Lodestone, Ring of Drums

column2: A cast within a moment's window as a condition on a Master's effects (within 0.5 s after a finisher, 0.3 s of a perfect dodge, 1 s of the last bolt falling), and an instant cast with no wind-up
column3: Chain Lance's, Seven Flashes', Waiting Thunder's and Thunderclap's Masters

column2: A base spell cast through its Learn mark with all its numbers, so its Empower's numbers beyond the wait count (patches burning 5 s, 55 stagger), and the element of a kit's cast, so a base spell's Master answers only its own element's with two elements carried
column3: Flame Wave's and Thunderclap's Empowers and Masters

column2: A spell held on its button (SpellSpec.HoldForm): a stance kept while held that banks the blows turned and answers on letting go; a clap that grows with the hold
column3: Kiln Stance's Learn (Shut Door) and Firewalker, Thunderclap's Held Thunder

column2: A coat on enemies that weapon blows spread to their neighbours and that lights on every coated enemy at once when any Burn touches one, scaled by the blows that spread it; a pool that coats who walks through it
column3: Black Pitch's Learn, Pitch Pool, The Torch's lighting, its Master

column2: A form's lasting things timed by the spec: a crater's burn, a stance's walk, a ring that stands its time and takes its drums with it
column3: Meteor Leap's Empower, Kiln Stance's Firewalker, Ring of Drums and its Empower

column2: An enemy beginning an attack (its wind-up) as a trigger marks can answer, and holding that wind-up a moment
A second press of a slot while its spell stands, casting its follow-up
column3: Lightning Rod's step, Thrown Rod and Master

column2: The stats ReactionDamage and ReactionStagger that every reaction's damage is multiplied by, and a reaction struck again where it happened
The RuleBook's first switches (task 4.4): no cooldown at all for a breath (SpellCooldowns.Frozen), burns that never go out by themselves
column3: In One Breath, Fire Without End

column2: A count with a rule of its own: a perfect guard beating two at once, three beats within 3 s keeping the ring, the third beat's great clap, beats banked for one heavy blow
column3: Ring of Drums' Learn, Drum Roll, Silent Drum and Master

column2: An enemy condition in which balance does not recover
The charged blade charged for five blows, not three
Enemies carried before a moving spell and thrown down at its end
Kindle's Fed Flame (each blow on a burning enemy adds 0.4 s, to twice its length; each blow taken smothers 2 s) in place of its burn, and Overdrive's critical chain-ender
